name: agent-goodput
description: Measure and improve verified useful work per token with quality-gated routing, context audits, delegation controls, paired benchmarks, and automatic rollback.

interface.shortDescription: Save tokens only when verified quality holds
interface.longDescription: Agent Goodput measures task outcomes, context, tool calls, routing, and delegation. Cheaper policies begin in shadow mode and advance only after paired deterministic evaluations establish quality noninferiority and token savings.
defaultPrompt: Audit this task's context and route, then show the quality gate and token evidence
